row.notes: Shared vslot (cells in many MY_TEAM_REWARDS vtables). Builds a string, fills it via this->vslot+0x30(this,&str), logs ' - %s' on MY_TEAM_REWARDS when channel hash 0x21c83a88 is enabled, frees it. 0x21c83a88 is the log-channel hash, not a name hash. (lane owner review requested) Better name: Game_MyTeamRewards_LogDescription (bound record keeps its name).

verify.notes: V9615 Formats an object via writer vtbl +0x30 into a string and logs " - %s" on channel MY_TEAM_REWARDS if enabled (channel hash 0x21c83a88); a logging helper, not an analytics event.
